note: Thresholds v2, confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12 before any strategy was validated ('keep it, we will improve over time'). Changes after observing results invalidate the affected validation, so an improvement is a new version applied to later studies. Not industry or regulatory standards. Passing means the research-validation policy passed, not readiness for live capital. Definitions: docs/validation.md. Version 3 (2026-11-16, owner: 'fix all the suggestions' of docs/research-review-2026-11-16.md, section 3.3): the fixed account-wide drawdown cap is switched off for long-only studies (owner_max_drawdown 1.0 = 100%, no absolute cap) because the owner moved the drawdown limit to a per-trade stop (2026-11-15); the strategy's drawdown is still judged against the benchmark's (max_drawdown_vs_benchmark 1.25). Applies to studies registered from now on; studies already judged under version 2 are re-run, not edited.
